scope: Recorded 20-question run: sample-1000 plus its recorded benchmark-additions extension.
sql: SELECT count(*) chunks, count(DISTINCT id) chunk_ids, count(DISTINCT accession) document_ids, count(DISTINCT (source_file,source_row)) source_records FROM read_parquet(?)

source_parquet_access.note: Agentic Search could additionally use these original source Parquet files; BM25/Vector/Hybrid searched the index.

definitions.document_ids: DISTINCT accession in indexed chunks; parsed filing accession, not company CIK.
definitions.source_records: DISTINCT (source_file,source_row), so repeated document IDs may occur.
definitions.chunks: Retrieval passages stored in each database, not documents.
